title: The Screenless Health Tracker That's Outselling Smartwatches in the UK

p.content: SPONSORED ARTICLE
The Screenless Health Tracker That's Outselling Smartwatches in the UK
By
CHRIS KOWALSKI
In Partnership With HLTH

As a longevity optimiser who’s always on the hunt for smarter, more affordable ways to take care of my body, the search for a trusted tracker almost never stops. I've been wearing a smartwatch every day for the last four years and was never able to fully trust the data. But the HLTH band – a screenless wearable that only tracks health, is the first one to change that. It's rated 4.6 on Trustpilot and has sold out three times since its release in the UK this April.
Here's why I'm putting my smartwatch in the drawer — and why you might want to do the same.
1. It takes 288 readings a day

p.alt: The HLTH companion app showing a day of blood pressure readings, with the band worn on the wrist

p.content:
Most wearables take a few readings an hour, then fill the gaps with estimates. HLTH Band takes 288 readings a day across blood pressure, heart rate, HRV, sleep and more. Plus its algorithm filters out noise automatically, so only clean data reaches your trends.

More readings means more accuracy. And more accuracy means you're seeing what's actually happening in your body.
2. No slimy subscriptions or hidden fees

This is the one that made me double-take. While most trackers charge you to rent your own health data and bury it in fine print, HLTH band is a one-time purchase. The app is completely free, and all your data – blood pressure trends, heart rate, HRV, sleep stages – is accessible from day one.

When you see the quality of the device and the data, the price genuinely feels like they've made a mistake.
GET UP TO £79 OFF HLTH BAND
3. Comfortable design you actually sleep in

p.alt: The HLTH Band worn on a wrist, showing its screenless fabric strap

p.content: HLTH Band weighs under 18 grams (less than 30 pence!), and uses non-itchy flexible material for the band that feels like nothing. That makes it easy to sleep with or wear for any occasion without looking like you’re sick or even wearing a health tracker. This isn’t just a cool design choice; it’s scientifically proven that most heart events and health issues happen at night. So nightly tracking is even more important than day time tracking.
4. Proven 30 day battery life

We all know that daily wear is key to finding our real baseline and avoiding health issues, but keeping trackers on is tricky when the battery dies daily. Enter HLTH Band’s Flow Sense Intelligent routing feature. Their advanced sensor watches your vitals and provides real-time adjustment to battery power, to prevent it from draining too fast.
The result? Battery life that lasts up to 30 days on a single charge. Whether you’re a busy professional, new parent, or retiree, I think we can all appreciate this feature.
GET UP TO £79 OFF HLTH BAND
5. Trend readings every 5 minutes

p.alt: An exploded view of the HLTH Band showing its sensor board and battery

p.content: Many devices on the market only take some readings at night or space them hours apart to save battery for screens. HLTH Band's continuous tracking spaces out readings as low as every 5 minutes, making it easier than ever to see how your food, sleep, workouts, and lifestyle habits impact your health. So any changes you make can be seen quickly in your numbers.
GET UP TO £79 OFF HLTH BAND
Ready to keep better watch of your health with HLTH Band?
From the continuous tracking and tight intervals to 30 day battery and comfortable design, HLTH Band is packed with features that make health tracking smarter, more accurate, and more affordable.

If you’re ready to keep a better eye on your health, protect your heart, and save money doing it. HLTH Band is the partner you’ve been waiting for. Now, THIS is one launch worth getting excited about.
